propositions: Coordinator must execute non-create atomic postconditions (update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, conflict) in dependency order within a single pass.
Late failure must preserve proven earlier postconditions and skip replay; re-observation of remaining drift defers to the next reconciliation pass.
Already-gone deletes and ticket-local 404 responses must be treated as idempotent successes scoped to the ticket, while broad permanent/auth/quota failures stop only their declared scope.

Coordinator must map normalized Disposition vocabulary (applied, recovered, deferred, failed, skipped, commit_unknown, exhausted_transient, dependency_deferred, scope_deferred, safety_aborted) to five exact per-ticket outcome buckets without overlap.
New coordinator logic must land in coordinator.py and failure_policy.py rather than growing dispatch_one.py, keeping existing dispatch leaves callable and new routing shadow/additive.
